An AI-powered quote poster tool that turns titles, quotes, reflections, and moods from books, films, and other cultural works into polished shareable check-in posters through the official Mew APIs. One-click transformation: Converts a title, quote, and takeaway into a complete social-ready poster. Mood-driven visuals: Builds an emotional background and typography direction that match the tone of the work. Perfect for sharing: Ideal for reading check-ins, movie reflections, and social posts on platforms like Moments and other.
